points.description: States the maximum average annual precipitation (mean of the annual maximum precipitation series) as a parameter influencing PMP estimation.
points.partial_credit: Half if only 'mean' or 'average precipitation' is given without 'maximum'/'annual maximum'.

points.description: States the standard deviation of the maximum (annual) precipitation as the second parameter.
points.partial_credit: Half if 'standard deviation' is given but not clearly linked to the precipitation series.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need both the mean of the annual maximum precipitation and its standard deviation, in any clear wording. Give 1 mark if only one is correct, or if both are stated vaguely (e.g. 'average rainfall and deviation'). Give 0 for unrelated parameters such as area, duration or slope only.
